__comment: SEED / test-grade C# spec corpus (po-av01j.10): RC-019 Network Timeout Enforcement and RC-022 Retry with Backoff at C# identities, plus the C# emission identities for the G4 lane and one job-altitude entry for G3. PRODUCTION corpus authoring rides the LLM factory and is HITL (gate-set mint bead under po-av01j) - these entries exist so the contract and e2e tests exercise real verdicts, nothing more. Identity convention: fully-qualified .NET type (namespace.Type), matching csindex's client_type emission.

apis.rationale: SEED RC-019: an HttpClient request blocks until the response completes; the bound is the client's Timeout property (100s default, configurable at construction) or a CancellationToken deadline at the call
SEED RC-019: same surface as GetAsync; the client's Timeout or a per-call CancellationToken bounds it
SEED RC-019: same surface as GetAsync; the client's Timeout or a per-call CancellationToken bounds it
SEED RC-019: a SqlCommand execution blocks on the server; CommandTimeout (30s default) bounds it at the command object
SEED RC-019: EF Core inherits the underlying provider's command timeout; whether the configured provider carries one is per-repo, so the spec alone cannot settle it
SEED RC-019: StackExchange.Redis operations are bounded by the multiplexer's SyncTimeout/AsyncTimeout configuration (5s default) set at ConnectionMultiplexer.Connect

SEED RC-019: a gRPC call has NO default deadline and waits forever; the bound is a deadline in CallOptions at the call. DateTime.MaxValue is gRPC's spelling of 'no deadline', so a deadline argument set to it is the unbounded case wearing a bound's name (po-av01j.25)

SEED RC-022: librdkafka retries delivery internally under message.timeout.ms (5min default) with backoff; whether app-level retry wrapping or a tighter bound is needed depends on the call's delivery semantics, so it routes to per-site judgment

SEED RC-022: BasicPublish writes to the client's outbound buffer and does not block on the broker; delivery-failure handling (publisher confirms, retry with backoff) is the RC-022 question and lives at the confirm/consumer surface, not this call
SEED job-altitude RC-019: a recurring job runs unattended against shared stores; the registration is the altitude where a run bound must exist

configs.rationale: HttpClient enforces a 100-second whole-call Timeout by default; the property must be explicitly set to InfiniteTimeSpan to remove it, so the type carries a whole-call bound
SqlCommand enforces a 30-second CommandTimeout by default; 0 (infinite) must be set explicitly

emissions.rationale: a catch that neither emits nor re-throws swallows the failure: invisible to centralized error monitoring (RC-027)
a structured log emission on the error path feeds central log aggregation
structured log emission: minimal queryable telemetry
a structured log emission on the error path feeds central log aggregation

sentry captures aggregate errors centrally with alerting
a System.Diagnostics activity (the .NET OTel surface) at the I/O boundary carries trace context end to end
